The user named above ("DMC User") agrees to comply with the terms of the Exclusive Seismic Data - Data Access & Confidentiality Agreement (the "Agreement") as it pertains to the disclosure of digital exclusive seismic data. Before a DMC user is permitted access to exclusive seismic data they will be required to agree to the terms of the Agreement by clicking the 'Accept' button when the Agreement is displayed. The CNSOER will monitor the data accessed by each DMC user. This information will be made available to the data owners and the DMC User hereby consents to the disclosure of this information. The DMC User agrees to indemnify and save harmless the CNSOER and the data owner and their respective affiliates, directors, officers, employees and agents from and against all actions, claims, damages, losses, expenses and costs, inclusive of special, indirect or consequential damages, including loss of profit or loss of competitive position by the data owner or DMC User, which they or any of them may sustain, incur or become liable for as a result of the disclosure of any DMC data to the DMC User or any of the DMC User's affiliates, directors, officers, employees or agents, and this indemnity shall continue in full force and effect and be applicable regardless of whether any such persons who have caused or contributed to such breach cease to be employed or engaged by the DMC User. Neither the data owner nor the CNSOER shall be liable in an action initiated by the DMC User for special, indirect or consequential damages resulting from the disclosure or use of any DMC data, including, without limitation, loss of profit or business interruptions, however same may be caused.
